name: CML API
description: CommerceML (1C) API layer: a 'cml' content entity that records each exchange, plus an XML parser suite that reads stored CommerceML files into catalog/group/property/product/offer/price/stock arrays and diagnostic admin pages.
project_description: CML API is the CommerceML/1C exchange API layer for Drupal commerce. It defines a 'cml' content entity that records each exchange (type catalog/sale, state new/progress/success/failure, full flag, 1C login and IP, and a field_file file reference to the received XML) and ships an XML parser service suite (XmlParser plus ParserCatalog/ParserProduct/ParserOffers/ParserPrices/ParserRests) that reads stored CommerceML XML into catalog groups, categories, properties, products and offers. A YAML-driven field map (cmlapi.mapsettings) controls how 1C node names are converted to product/offer fields; a Cleaner service prunes old/empty exchanges on cron. Four permission-gated admin diagnostic pages render the parsed catalog tree (jsTree), products, offers and category scheme. 2.x adds MoySklad exchange-source detection and nested-group handling. Typically paired with drupal/cmlexchange (the exchange HTTP endpoint) and drupal/cmlmigrations (the migrate importers).
